title: Ukraine Cites Serious Battlefield Disruptions From Starshield Limits
summary: Ukrainian officials warn that renewed restrictions on SpaceX's Starshield satellite network are crippling drone defense operations.
paragraphs: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky stated on Thursday that military units have encountered significant fresh disruptions to the Starshield satellite communications network across the front line and in Russian-occupied regions, France 24 reported. The military-grade satellite system was designed by SpaceX specifically for government and national security applications, CNBC reported.

According to Euronews, Ukraine reported that reimposed speed restrictions on the network are severely impairing the military's ability to intercept Russian drones along the front lines. The new operational impediments emerge only weeks after previous restrictions had been removed, Euronews reported, with Zelensky warning that the disruptions result directly in more Ukrainian deaths, according to France 24.

title: Historic Ocean Liner SS United States Deliberately Sunk off Florida
summary: The famed SS United States liner was scuttled off the Florida coast to be transformed into an artificial reef.
paragraphs: The historic ocean liner SS United States, once celebrated as the fastest ship on the seas, completed its final voyage on Wednesday by sinking beneath the waters off Florida's coast, Euronews reported. The vessel's submersion concludes decades of service and debate surrounding the preservation of the renowned American transatlantic ship.

BBC News reported that the ship was sunk deliberately to create the largest artificial ocean reef in the world. The planned reefing went ahead despite previous campaigns by preservation activists who had pushed to convert the historic vessel into a permanent museum, according to BBC News.
